baseline.save_success: Only reports saved when api.saveWorkspace() returns true. Failure stays visible after reopening.
baseline.capability_upgrade: Rebuilds current comparison at zero; preserves old baseline and subscription as a review/export copy. If archive budget is exhausted, old baseline remains exportable in the current session.

data_assertions.pdf_pages: Only provided page-numbered parsed text; no inferred PDF pages.

integration.merge_semantics: Validates existing and incoming owned fields before mutation. Invalid/over-limit imports reject atomically. Same-ID same-name groups union members; name conflicts get deterministic import copies. Local task edits, baseline and subscription win; conflicting imported copies remain reviewable and duplicate imports are idempotent.

version_check.trigger: Manual 检查最新资料版本
version_check.endpoint: serviceClient.status({signal}), with request(/api/changes,{signal}) fallback when status method is absent
version_check.same: Shows no different published snapshot found.
version_check.different: Warns service/browser datasets differ and offers reloading the published page; password is required after refresh. Does not claim that publication has already caught up.
version_check.collector_semantics: database/state ready means retrieval readiness; collection requires explicit task evidence.

limitations: Preview tests exercise already-published encrypted assets and never rebuild them.
Static snapshot history and browser-local conditions do not provide background collection or push notifications.
Source content_hash remains distinct from SHA-256 of delivered full original/translation strings.

followup_verifications.change: Preserve omitted and explicitly empty validated optional fields during backup merge; conflict copies and atomic bounds stay enforced.
